imageNote: The capstone is a project brief pulling together everything from Chapters 1-6 (operators and dependencies, Connections, sensors/branching, the ELT + dbt + Snowflake pipeline, error handling and alerting, and monitoring) into one assignment the student builds themselves — not new external material to research or a single GUI screen to screenshot. There is no one 'correct' screenshot for a student's own DAG. Covered with an honest original LTV steps diagram laying out the project's deliverables, consistent with how this catalog's other capstone-brief lessons are handled (e.g. Git/GitHub/CI-CD's Chapter 6 capstone, Snowflake's Chapter 15 capstone, dbt's Chapter 9 capstone).
